recommended_role: Independent whole-answer geometry relation partition, supplementary to interpretable structural classes; do not create an unvalidated A2 x B cross-product taxonomy.

worker_labels.csv.development_selector: stage=development_frozen; K choice is recorded separately in candidate_selection.csv
worker_labels.csv.class_id: A01/A02/A03 are condition-specific all-data relation names. unknown marks insufficient ordinary formal history (at least 6 images and 3 buildings are required).
worker_labels.csv.absence: Only workers represented in each condition's formal original-answer inventory occur here. W019/W026 have no such formal classification records; full non-OOS personnel inventory must be joined externally, not inferred from this table.

worker_labels_lobo.csv.class_id: Actual target-building-excluded fitted partition ID; use this grouping for target-building raw-answer and fusion evaluation.
worker_labels_lobo.csv.aligned_class_id: Same fold partition renamed by overlap with descriptive full-data names only for display. Renaming does not change co-membership or target validation.
worker_labels_lobo.csv.n_train_images_and_buildings: Actual per-person support after excluding the entire target building; unknown reasons are retained.

validation_files.selected_method_validation.csv: Only independently selected K for A1 and A2, with development stability and independent-check/LOBO/Q-source-matched outcomes. within_minus_between is negative for a smaller distance and positive for a larger coassignment or overlap.
validation_files.A2_class_pair_geometry.csv: Class-specific LOBO pair distances; availability differs by class pair, so these raw averages are not a matched class-specific causal contrast.
validation_files.A_Q_source_matched_validation.csv: Within-image same-count comparisons jointly stratified by the shared pair count, origin pair, target pair mean-Q bin and target pair Q-difference bin. n_pairs is before matching; n_pairs_contributing counts both sides of matched strata; n_pairs_unmatched is their difference. Q is used for validation sensitivity only, never fitting.
validation_files.B_raw_answer_validation.csv: Independent raw-answer check of route-B target-building-excluded structural coarse/fine labels. Matched rows also stratify by shared pair count and expose before/contributing/unmatched pair counts. Structural similarity does not automatically imply whole-answer geometry similarity.
validation_files.A2_doorway_validation.csv: Ordinary-trained A2 labels applied to doorway images, with target whole building excluded; this is a separate extrapolation check.

geometry_metrics.same_count: Equal bound corner-pair count, not equal total points after dropping invalid positions; declared valid frozen points are kept unchanged.
geometry_metrics.bound_deg: Frozen cyclic bottleneck maximum of top/bottom spherical angular distances under one shared cyclic shift; no independent top/bottom reassignment or arbitrary point permutation.
geometry_metrics.bottom_deg_top_deg: Bottom/top maximum angular distance using the same shift chosen by bound_deg.
geometry_metrics.floor_iou: Continuous original camera-height-normalized footprints, valid polygons only; not a new Q score or a repaired ring.
geometry_metrics.same9_same12: Existing affinity partition co-membership at whole-answer 9/12 degree thresholds, never cross-image cluster-number equality.

coverage_entry: ../evidence/INVENTORY_RECEIPT.json and inventory_usage_by_image.csv / inventory_usage_by_worker.csv distinguish 9217 non-OOS behavior records, classification training observations, 7302 original-answer formal records and actual fusion membership.
case_geometry_receipt: A2_7y21_geometry_receipt.json records individual simple floor validity and exact equality to the available frozen processed inputs; no new original export is claimed.
